blocks.hero_subtitle: Importing a 2012–2014 Lexus IS F into NZ means finding the exact USE20 F-series sedan—not just any IS with a large engine. Before you approve a bid, we confirm the exact model code, grade, auction listing, estimated landed cost and import viability.
proof_points: Direct access to Japanese vehicle auctions
Import estimate before bidding, with NZ entry certification included in the process
blocks.why_kiwis_buy: Kiwi buyers choose the IS F for its Lexus F-series V8 in a sedan body. Catalogue data for DBA-USE20 describes a four-door, four-seat car with a 4968 cc V8, 8AT and FR layout, so it retains useful everyday practicality—but its running costs are not those of an ordinary low-cost daily driver.
blocks.video_caption: The video should show the USE20 side profile and its four-seat cabin. This makes it clear how the IS F differs from the RC F coupe and the larger GS F.
blocks.main_usp_deep: The main reason to consider a Lexus IS F is the character of the DBA-USE20 F-series V8 sedan. We cover the 2UR-GSE, 8AT and FR combination below. Before bidding, we also confirm whether the vehicle is a standard IS F or a Dynamic Sport Tuning grade. Goo-net Exchange lists Dynamic Sport Tuning as a separate grade under DBA-USE20, but the equipment and differences on any particular car must be confirmed from its auction information.

buyer_persona.headline: Best suited for:
buyer_persona.body: This car suits a buyer who wants a four-door Lexus F-series V8 and accepts higher running costs than a regular IS. If low ownership costs or maximum cabin space matter more, there are calmer alternatives. If the goal is a rare USE20 V8 Lexus, the IS F is a compelling choice.

car_specs_benefits.benefit: The body code keeps the auction search focused on the IS F rather than other IS variants; catalogue data identifies DBA-USE20 as the code for the 2012–2014 IS F.

Catalogue data lists four doors and four seats, so the IS F remains a practical sedan—but it is not a five-seat family car.

standout_features_block.intro: These are practical, verifiable body and seating details listed for the DBA-USE20.

items.title: Four-door sedan body
items.body: The IS F USE20 is a four-door sedan. For an NZ buyer, that means easier rear-seat access than an RC F while retaining the F-series V8.

items.title: Four-seat cabin
items.body: Catalogue data lists four seats. This matters: the IS F should not be treated as a full five-seat family sedan.

tech_deep_dive_block.headline: Under the skin
tech_deep_dive_block.intro: What matters in an IS F is the exact mechanical specification: body code, V8, automatic transmission and FR layout.

items.title: 2012–2014 USE20 production scope
items.body: This search is limited to 2012–2014 Lexus IS F vehicles with the USE20 code. Goo-net Exchange lists the period from August 2012 to 23 July 2014 for this code. Visually similar IS models with another body code are outside this search. The exact vehicle must be confirmed as DBA-USE20 before bidding.

items.title: 2UR-GSE 5.0 V8
items.body: For the USE20, catalogue data specifies the 2UR-GSE: a 4968 cc, 5.0-litre DOHC petrol V8. It is central to the IS F character—a large V8 in a relatively compact sedan. If output is important to your bid, we confirm the figure from the auction information for the specific car. Engine condition is never inferred from the model alone; it is assessed only from the information available for that listing.

items.title: 8AT and FR layout
items.body: Catalogue data specifies an eight-speed automatic transmission and an FR layout: a front-mounted engine driving the rear wheels. Because the front axle does not deliver power, this layout supports a more direct steering feel. It is one of the main reasons to consider the IS F as a performance sedan rather than simply a Lexus with a large engine.

models_comparison.intro: This comparison is limited to the USE20 IS F and the specified Dynamic Sport Tuning grade.

blocks.how_to_use_iyc: Tell us your preferred year, budget, whether you favour the standard IS F or Dynamic Sport Tuning, and any mileage limits. Before you bid, we check available vehicles in Japan, the estimated landed cost, auction listing and import viability.

faq_block.q: Can you search specifically for a Lexus IS F Dynamic Sport Tuning USE20?
faq_block.a: Yes, but availability must be checked against current auctions. Goo-net Exchange lists Dynamic Sport Tuning under DBA-USE20, while the exact specification of each vehicle is confirmed from its listing.

faq_block.q: How much does it cost to import an IS F into NZ?
faq_block.a: We calculate the price from a live auction example and a current import estimate before bidding. Without a specific vehicle, there is no honest way to give a final landed cost.

faq_block.q: Can I know in advance whether the car will pass NZ entry certification?
faq_block.a: Import viability must be checked for the exact model code and vehicle before bidding; final certification occurs in NZ. The outcome depends on the individual car, its documents and condition, any modifications, and inspections after arrival.

faq_block.q: How long does the import take after an auction purchase?
faq_block.a: Timing depends on the purchase date, vessel availability, document processing, customs clearance and the steps required after arrival in NZ. We provide updates throughout the process instead of promising a fixed date in advance.

faq_block.q: What do you check in the auction information?
faq_block.a: We translate and explain the available auction listing, including the grade, mileage, condition notes, recorded damage, modifications and any attached records. If information is missing or unclear, we say so.

blocks.company_positioning: ImportYourCar.co.nz is an NZ-based vehicle import service operating since 2009. We help private buyers search Japanese auctions, understand auction information, approve a bid, and work through purchasing, shipping, customs clearance and the steps after arrival in NZ.
